content: These references include research on different circumcision techniques, devices like the ShangRing and PrePex, and their implementation in various countries, particularly in sub-Saharan Africa. The studies also explore the economic, ethical, and logistical aspects of scaling up VMMC programs, as well as the perceptions and experiences of clients and healthcare providers. Additionally, the references touch on broader topics such as adolescent health, HIV prevention strategies, and global health ethics.
